P(sport | freshman) = 0.500, but P(sport) = 132/241 ≈ 0.548. These are not equal, so the events are not independent.
answers.final_answer: Not independent: 0.500 ≠ 0.548

answers.brief_reasoning: Interpret the interval in context, then explain what the confidence level means.
answers.final_answer: We are 95% confident that the true proportion of all freshmen who play a sport is between 0.410 and 0.590. The 95% level means that if we took many random samples of 118 freshmen and built an interval this way from each one, about 95% of those intervals would contain the true proportion.
